subject: english-language
title: English Through Time
welcome_lead: English isn't fixed — it has shifted hugely across centuries.
meta_desc: KS3 English Language adventure on historical change in English.
final_note: You can now name the main eras of English and a key change.

walkthroughs.body_html: English moves from Old English (Beowulf) to Middle English (Chaucer) to Early Modern (Shakespeare) to Modern.
English has masses of loanwords: 'café' (French), 'kindergarten' (German), 'curry' (Tamil). Borrowing keeps the language growing.
Words like 'selfie', 'hangry' or 'rizz' are neologisms — newly minted. Each generation adds its own batch.
